description: Canonical MLS (RFC 9420) ciphersuite vocabulary for v1 KeyPackage cipher_suites[] negotiation and server describe surfaces. Completes the algorithm-agility registry symmetry with digest-suite-registry.json, signature-alg-registry.json and hpke-suite-registry.json.
registry_rules: Schema / describe enum values for MLS ciphersuite fields MUST be generated from active rows' canonical_id only when publishing a new schema/describe contract version, then frozen for that version. Activating a reserved/new suite requires a new contract version and profile negotiation; registry activation MUST NOT expand an existing schema enum in place (zh/conformance/schema-registry.md §6.1 b.1).

A ciphersuite not present as an active row MUST fail closed in KeyPackage claim / group negotiation (unsupported ciphersuite); receivers MUST NOT accept unregistered suites even if the underlying MLS library supports them.

New suites (e.g. ChaCha20-Poly1305 for AES-accelerator-less devices) enter additively as new rows with their own profile gates and conformance vectors; the registry stays minimal for classical suites, but pre-registers post-quantum hybrid rows as status=reserved to match the HPKE / TLS PQ pre-registration discipline (hpke-suite-registry.json, transport-bindings.md §5).

status=reserved rows pin the canonical_id, profile gate and activation_requirements but MUST NOT appear on wire until every activation_requirements entry is met and the row is flipped to active in a registry release. Receivers MUST fail closed (unsupported ciphersuite) on a reserved suite seen in KeyPackage cipher_suites[] or group negotiation before activation — same discipline as encryption-and-audit.md 'MLS 内容 KEM 边界'.

ciphersuites.security_note: RFC 9420 mandatory-to-implement suite; classical X25519 KEM (not post-quantum). Conformance pins the MLS WG byte-level vector corpus at commit cfd450286d1bfd9cd2519b95c80f9771f94a5b1a; implementations MUST run all cases for ciphersuite 0x0001 in the listed files.

activation_requirements: The exact suite mapping MUST match draft-ietf-mls-pq-ciphersuites-05: MLKEM768-X25519 KEM 0x647A, SHAKE256 KDF 0x0011, AES-128-GCM AEAD 0x0001, SHA256 transcript hash and ed25519 signature; any incompatible MLS/HPKE/CFRG draft change requires an explicit registry release and refreshed KAT digest

IETF/IANA MLS ciphersuite code point assigned for MLS_128_MLKEM768X25519_AES128GCM_SHA256_Ed25519 and recorded here as rfc9420_id (registry release required; receivers MUST NOT improvise a private code point)
Per-suite MLS conformance vectors published (KeyPackage encoding, welcome/commit KEM encap/decap, group key schedule)

Coverage-priority alignment recorded: activates only after the non-MLS HPKE row for the same MLKEM768-X25519/X-Wing construction (hpke-suite-registry.json ak.hpke_xwing_aead_chacha20poly1305.v1) — static ciphertext backups are the primary Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later target, MLS group KEM is the second wave
ciphersuites.security_note: Reserved MLS WG post-quantum hybrid suite using MLKEM768-X25519, AES-128-GCM, SHA256 and classical Ed25519 signatures. The CFRG concrete construction is identical to X-Wing, retained only as a supplemental KEM reference; MLS naming and activation track draft-ietf-mls-pq-ciphersuites. This suite targets post-quantum confidentiality, not post-quantum authentication. Not on wire until activated; receivers MUST fail closed on this suite before activation.
